mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing clear skies and a comfortable 77 degrees near Verona City Hall. The moon is currently in a Waning Gibbous phase.

The Verona Police Department reminds residents that accident reports and other public records can be requested in person, by phone, or online through their website. Most requests are processed within 10 business days, though some confidential information may be redacted according to state law.

There is a lot going on this week, starting with the Remote Area Medical clinic today at the high school. Looking ahead, we have trivia nights starting at Hop Haus and the Wisconsin Brewing Company this coming Tuesday.
Looking at the weekly report, an incident occurred last Saturday where an 83-year-old woman was involved in a hit-and-run near West Verona Avenue and Epic Lane.
Stop by for some OREO Cookie Cheesecake today before the store closes at 10 PM. Also, remember that Kona Ice is at Fireman's Park today until 2 PM.
